# HiAPI GPT Image 2.5 Agent Skill

HiAPI Agent Skill for GPT Image 2.5 Flare and Sunburst — default mode models `gpt-image-2.5-flare/text-to-image`, `gpt-image-2.5-flare/image-to-image`, `gpt-image-2.5-sunburst/text-to-image`, `gpt-image-2.5-sunburst/image-to-image`, plus the explicit quality-tier IDs `gpt-image-2.5-flare` and `gpt-image-2.5-sunburst` — covering AI image generation, image editing, preflight estimates, idempotent async tasks, recovery, and output download.

- [README](README.md): installation, scenarios, examples, and FAQ
- [Skill instructions](SKILL.md): invocation boundary and workflow
- [API contract](references/api.md): fields, enums, defaults, pricing snapshot
- [Output and recovery](references/output.md): polling, download, and QC
- [Agent installation](llms-install.md): local installer and planned public command

- [Flare image-to-image docs](https://www.hiapi.ai/docs/models/image/gpt-image-2-5-flare-image-to-image/)
- [Sunburst text-to-image docs](https://www.hiapi.ai/docs/models/image/gpt-image-2-5-sunburst-text-to-image/)
- [Sunburst image-to-image docs](https://www.hiapi.ai/docs/models/image/gpt-image-2-5-sunburst-image-to-image/)
- [Flare quality-tier docs](https://www.hiapi.ai/docs/models/image/gpt-image-2-5-flare/)
- [Sunburst quality-tier docs](https://www.hiapi.ai/docs/models/image/gpt-image-2-5-sunburst/)
